title: itembank normalized source document
description: The strict locator-faithful normalization contract (Phase 11, D-01/D-03/D-04). A normalized document is a derived, versioned record of a read-only source: exact spans with heading paths, line/character locators, and verbatim text, plus extracted objective candidates that retain their originating span. Reconstructing every span from recorded offsets must yield byte-for-byte-equivalent Unicode text (11-03 fidelity requirement).

schema_version.description: This document's own schema version; must equal x-itembank-version.

source_id.description: The caller-supplied stable identity of the source (D-01).

kind.description: The registered adapter that produced this record. PDF/DOCX remain unsupported until the locator-fidelity gate proves exact round-trips (D-03, 11-AI-SPEC).

fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 (hex) of the exact original source bytes; a report is stale when the current bytes' fingerprint differs (D-04).

byte_length.description: The original source byte length (schema-bounded ingestion, T-11-10).

spans.description: Ordered exact spans; offsets are 0-based character offsets into the decoded text.

objective_candidates.description: Deterministic objective candidates from headings, list entries, and declarative body sentences, each retaining its exact originating span (AUDIT-01).

span_id.description: The stable identity of this span within the document; citations address spans by this id.

kind.description: The span's role; objective extraction never collapses to heading scraping (AUDIT-01). Blank spans carry empty verbatim so reconstruction is byte-exact.

verbatim.description: The exact text of the span, reconstructible from the recorded offsets.

objective_candidate.description: For heading/list spans, the candidate text carried by the span itself.

heading_path.description: The markdown heading stack the span sits under, outermost first; empty for text sources.

start_char.description: 0-based character offset of the span's first character.

end_char.description: 0-based character offset one past the span's last character.

key.description: The canonical candidate key (a subject:path when the source line carries one, else the collapsed lowercased text). Coverage rows match bank objectives by exact key equality.

span_id.description: The exact span this candidate came from; the citation for this objective addresses this span.
